plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week off-camp build for boxing with one efficient full-body S&C session each week so you can keep sparring and skill work high. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lower-body lift, then Weeks 2-4 build strength and power with simple, safe exercises that are easy to learn and recover from. Volume stays tight because combat load is the priority.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body strength, upper-body support strength, and simple explosive work without adding unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength work and keep power crisp while adjusting volume around sparring and boxing workload.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift toward faster, sharper force production with enough strength work to hold onto the gains from earlier phases.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a box height you can land on quietly and confidently. Step down each rep and keep every jump fast and clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if boxes are limited or if jumping onto a box feels less comfortable.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps in load, then work up to one hard but technically solid set of 3-5 reps. Keep the last clean rep in you and log the load and reps because this sets your baseline for future percentage work.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your training max for future weeks.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if shoulder position in the back squat feels awkward.

substitutionOptions.name: Goblet Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this only if barbell squatting is not comfortable enough to assess safely.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Use a controlled lowering phase and drive up hard. Stop with 2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
